verdict.rationale: gstack's own docs show two install scopes: the upgrade skill "detects global vs vendored install" [gstack-docs-7], and "project-local setup never silently replaces a global install" [gstack-docs-49]. Both come from passing mentions rather than a dedicated install-scope guide, so the depth is unproven. missing for 10: documented install commands or flags for picking each scope, explicit confirmation that the vendored/project-local files are meant to be committed to the repo, and independent or hands-on corroboration of both modes.
